new.s: Which satakam did Kancherla Gopanna (Bhakta Ramadasu) compose while imprisoned in Golconda fort?

new.s:
Match the following:

A. Dasarathi Satakam
B. Srikalahasteeswara Satakam

new.s: Which place in Kadapa district is held by one tradition to be the birthplace of Bammera Potana?
